If you use SeekDeep in published work, please cite:

::: {#refs}
:::

Please also give the SeekDeep version you used (`SeekDeep` with no arguments prints it). If you
ran it through elucidatornf, give the elucidatornf commit or release as well.

SeekDeep is developed by the [Bailey Lab](https://github.com/bailey-lab). The source code is on
[GitHub](https://github.com/bailey-lab/SeekDeep), under the [license](https://github.com/bailey-lab/SeekDeep/blob/master/LICENSE) in the repository.
